note: Words no username or display name may use (server/accounts/names.js). Matched after the same lookalike normalization as reserved names (0→o, 1→i/l, 3→e, 4→a, 5→s, 7→t, @→a, $→s, separators removed). 'contains' words are refused anywhere inside a name; 'exact' words only as the whole name (or, in a display name, a whole word), because they are also parts of ordinary words.
